message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data in this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  
For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and view the current AQI, pollutant breakdown, and health advisories. |
| **Local news sites** | Many local stations (e.g., KABC, KTLA) publish live air‑quality dashboards. |
| **Weather apps** | Apps like Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the built‑in weather app on iOS/Android often include an AQI widget. |
| **Mobile apps** | “AirVisual”, “Plume Labs: Air Report”, or “AQICN” provide real‑time AQI and forecast. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and ask “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles?” They pull the latest data from AirNow or similar services.
